H. Res. 1665 (119th) — Providing for consideration of H.R. 3495 and H.R. 5267 (rule)

Sets the terms of House debate for H.R. 3495 (Direct Seller and Real Estate Agent Harmonization Act) and H.R. 5267 (American Franchise Act), including amendment and procedural rules for floor consideration.

Status: Rule reported/updated Nov 18, 2026; scheduled for House floor consideration (week of Nov 16, 2026)

Window: Scheduled/updated Nov 16-18, 2026 (House floor week of Nov 16); vote possible in Nov 16-Dec 31 window

Community vote (litmus test): [LITMUS TEST] H. Res. 1665 (119th): "Providing for consideration of H.R. 3495 and H.R. 5267 (rule)" — Should this measure pass? Cast a community vote (without middlemen) to compare community will with how representatives vote.

Campaign: Open-ended; timer begins once $10,000 is funded. Honest-zero (funded $0.00, 0 votes) until real on-chain activity is recorded.

Bounty beneficiaries: Bounty benefits verified local/community 501(c)(3) entities aligned to campaign impact (selected per governance).

items.title: H.R. 8552: Veterans’ Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2026
items.content_html:
H.R. 8552 (119th) — Veterans’ Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2026

Requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to increase wartime disability compensation, additional compensation for dependents, the clothing allowance for certain disabled veterans, and dependency and indemnity compensation for surviving spouses and children by the same percentage as the Social Security cost-of-living increase effective December 1, 2026, and to publish the increased amounts in the Federal Register.

Status: Presented to President (Nov 17, 2026); passed House by voice vote (Nov 9, 2026) and passed Senate without amendment by voice vote (Nov 11, 2026)

Source: https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/house-bill/8552
